name: Create Work Items from Technical Research
script:
# Create Work Items from rows in Technical Research request without notifying user
work_items = frappe.form_dict.get("work_item", [])

for row in work_items:
    new_work_item = frappe.new_doc("Work Item")
    new_work_item.work_item_type = row.get("work_item_type")
    new_work_item.title = row.get("title")
    new_work_item.description = row.get("description")
    new_work_item.insert()

frappe.response["message"] = {
    "created_count": len(work_items),
    "status": "success"
}
